algebraic_realization_audit.conclusion: No involution of a K3 surface whose full Neron-Severi lattice is U+E8(-1)+D6(-1) can induce the proposed small wall action.
algebraic_realization_audit.involution_gluing_obstruction: If an involution f of a K3 surface with full NS=N induces J, then f acts on the period by epsilon=+/-1. The opposite eigenspace in T=N^perp is rational and orthogonal to the period, hence would contain an extra integral (1,1) class. Thus f|T=epsilon*I. Since A_T is 2-elementary, +/-I acts trivially on A_T; unimodular K3 gluing forces J to act trivially on A_N. The explicit dual witness disproves this.
algebraic_realization_audit.special_period_warning: A realization after a Picard-rank jump would no longer inherit the certified completeness of the 19-wall nef configuration.

conclusion.summary: The proposed diagram fold is an exact finite-volume noncompact H14 Coxeter polytope, but the specified small involution cannot be realized on a K3 with this full NS.

fixed_nef_fold.completeness_argument: The source supplies all 19 nef inequalities. On a fixed class, the two inequalities in each 2-cycle have equal pairing and collapse to their orbit-sum inequality; singleton inequalities remain unchanged. The 17 cycles cover all 19 walls.

source.published_model: Double cover of P2 branched over a sextic with an A13 singularity
source.scope: Full nef chambers of general complex projective K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group in Picard ranks 15 through 19
